decision_rules.laterality: Left/right is anatomical from the depicted figure's body, not the viewer's side.
decision_rules.lying_side: For a reclining figure, left/right is the anatomical side in contact with the support surface; use unclear when contact cannot be determined.
decision_rules.C1.1_vs_C1.3: Use C1.1 when the pelvis is supported and locomotion/dance is not dominant. Use C1.3 when a step, directional transfer, dance, jump or other dynamic action is the dominant posture.
decision_rules.C2.1_vs_C2.2: Use C2.1 only when the crossed legs form a visibly closed/locked configuration. Use C2.2 when the legs cross but remain open or are not visibly locked; leave L2 blank when the evidence is insufficient.
decision_rules.C2.6_vs_C2.7_vs_C2.8: Use C2.6 for two-foot support without a clear weight shift, C2.7 for two-foot support with clear asymmetric weight, and C2.8 when one leg is the support while the other is bent or raised.
decision_rules.C2.9_vs_C2.10: Use C2.9 for a visible step or directional locomotion. Use C2.10 for dance or another dynamic pose where stepping is not the defining action.
decision_rules.insufficient_l2_evidence: Leave Level 2 blank rather than choosing the nearest class.
decision_rules.multi_limb: Retain the record and provenance, but set eligibility=exclude and exclusion_reason=multi_limb; exclude it from L1, L2 and keypoint pilot tasks.

changes: Frozen the pilot scope at 157 reviewed images in the 100-200 band.
Defined anatomical left/right and reclining side by contact with the support surface.
Added decision rules for the main ambiguous L1/L2 class pairs.
Excluded multi-limb figures from every current pilot task while retaining their records.
Confirmed 156 usable images and internal/research-only use with no public dataset release.
Documented the current pre-label pipeline and separated it from planned baselines.

ai_pipeline_policy.historical_normalization_assumption: For retrospective correction-rate reporting only, earlier Gemini predictions are treated as equivalent outputs of the current geometry pipeline plus manual semantic review. Original provider metadata is retained and is not rewritten.

operational_roles.geometry: The active custom Thangka pose checkpoint creates editable bbox and COCO-17 keypoint pre-labels.
operational_roles.semantic_labels: Level 1 and Level 2 are assigned and confirmed manually under the annotation guideline.
operational_roles.review: Only an explicit human review can set human_verified or approve a record.

historical_experiments.level_1_level_2_resnet18: Archived seed_v2 exploratory baseline; not part of the operational pipeline.
historical_experiments.rtmpose: Retained for explicit manual/offline comparison only; never an automatic fallback.

data_governance_policy.publication_rule: Use only for the internal, noncommercial IT-course project: model training, evaluation and an internal course report. Do not publish or redistribute raw images, the dataset, or trained weights outside the project.
data_governance_policy.rights_scope_rule: The source-specific license or rights notice remains controlling. verified means an explicit license/public-domain statement was found; research_only means the image is traceable and may be used in this controlled internal scope, but no public-release or external-redistribution right is inferred.
data_governance_policy.training_readiness_rule: approved + human_verified + source_id/source_url + rights_status in {verified,research_only} + review_protocol_status in {double_review_agreed,adjudicated}.
data_governance_policy.internal_report_rule: Report aggregate results and only the minimum attributed examples needed for the course; keep the report private to the course/project reviewers and do not place raw images or the dataset at a public URL.
